true_answer: Multiple notions exist, and deﬁning time in a manner applicable to all ﬁelds without circularity has consistently eluded scholars.[7] [10][11] Nevertheless, diverse ﬁelds such as business, industry, sports, the sciences, and the performing arts all incorporate some notion of time into their respective measuring systems.[12][13][14] Traditional deﬁnitions of time involved the observation of periodic motion such as the apparent motion of the sun across the sky, the phases of the moon, and the passage of a free-swinging pendulum.
